title: Chapter 1374 - 2: The Void

Chapter 1374 - 2: The Void

Chapter 1374: Chapter 2: The Void

’Gray Ancestor’ is just like that; the exploration of endless years has finally allowed Him to comprehend His own Origin Dao, becoming a Second Realm time lifeform.

It was only while passing near the Milky Way dimension that ’Gray Ancestor’ occasionally glanced towards the Milky Way dimension and discovered that the recently condensed Heart of Heavenly River was extremely unusual and would, in the distant future, transform into one of the raw materials for a lord-level weapon.

Every extended epoch, the Milky Way dimension would condense a Heart of Heavenly River. The previous Hearts of Heavenly River were relatively ordinary, only this recently condensed Heart of Heavenly River has the potential to become a lord-level weapon material.

Of course, to discover this, one must delve deeply into the future timeline observation. As a Second Realm time lifeform, ’Gray Ancestor’ far exceeds a First Realm time lifeform in terms of timeline observation.

Therefore, He discovered in advance the uniqueness of the recently condensing Heart of Heavenly River.

"What’s the matter?"

’Gray Ancestor’ spoke in a calm tone.

The reason He didn’t seize the Heart of Heavenly River Himself but instead commanded the time lifeforms of the Milky Way dimension to act was that this was the future timeline ’Gray Ancestor’ saw as having the best hope of successfully obtaining that Heart of Heavenly River.

If ’Gray Ancestor’ acted directly? A Second Realm time lifeform descending to seize the Heart of Heavenly River would likely incite hostility from all the resident time lifeforms within the Milky Way dimension.

Leading to a scenario where they join forces to resist this Second Realm time lifeform.

Besides, treasures like the Heart of Heavenly River shouldn’t ostensibly attract a Second Realm time lifeform.

If ’Gray Ancestor’ forcibly took action, it would prompt the multitudinous time lifeforms within the Milky Way dimension to reassess the value of this Heart of Heavenly River.

The fact that ’Gray Ancestor’ could discover the distinct nature of this Heart of Heavenly River in advance is primarily due to His farther observation of the timeline and also because other First Realm time lifeforms have not expended much effort or cost to observe the newly born Heart of Heavenly River.

After all, several Hearts of Heavenly River have been condensed previously in the Milky Way dimension without any notable peculiarities.

But if ’Gray Ancestor’ took action, the situation would be different. Given their sensitive nature, time lifeforms would immediately infer numerous reasons before conducting an in-depth timeline observation.

Once the true value of the recently condensed Heart of Heavenly River is revealed, the attracted Second Realm time lifeforms would not be limited to only Him, Gray Ancestor.

It is precisely because of the aforementioned reasons.

Even with an intense desire for that Heart of Heavenly River.

Gray Ancestor absolutely cannot act Himself, nor can He reveal even a hint of His own whereabouts.

A Second Realm time lifeform making every effort to conceal Himself makes it challenging for a First Realm time lifeform to detect much in the future timeline.

They would only feel the future timeline becoming blurred and distorted, with many results being quite indeterminate.

But this is also normal; involving the future timeline of time lifeforms is always like this.

...

"We can’t do anything about those seven time lifeforms from the Chaos Void."

The Master of Taixu looked at ’Gray Ancestor’ and said straightforwardly.

"Can’t do anything?"

Gray Ancestor frowned but didn’t say much.

He too has observed the future timeline many times and knows well the troublesome nature of that ’Lord Mo Xu’ from the Chaos Void.

But if the Master of Taixu truly couldn’t do anything, that would be too modest.

It’s merely a reluctance to pay too high a cost.

If the nine time lifeforms from the Taixu dimension truly went all out against the seven time lifeforms from the Chaos Void in desperate combat,

the latter would most likely concede voluntarily, as there’s no need to perish together with the Taixu dimension over a Heart of Heavenly River.

"I obtained this treasure from trading inside a certain lord’s domain."

Gray Ancestor raised His hand, and a palm-sized ax floated before Him.

This ax appeared exceptionally small, yet the faint aura it emitted was enough to alarm ordinary First Realm time lifeforms.

"This treasure?"

The Master of Taixu’s eyes turned solemn.

He could feel the terror of this ax; though it could only be wielded a few times, it was entirely possible to heavily injure a First Realm time lifeform.

"I have already shrouded this item with the power of time, making it impossible for ordinary First Realm Shisan tiers to observe in future timelines; you just need to activate it at the crucial moment."

Gray Ancestor’s words were succinct.

The cost He had already borne to obtain that Heart of Heavenly River with lord-level potential was considerable.

"Naturally so."

The Master of Taixu flashed a smile.

This is the dreaded aspect of time lifeforms traversing countless epochs.

It’s not just a matter of enhanced strength but also an increase in the variety of contingencies and backdrop gains from the many places explored.

"I hope you don’t let me down."

Gray Ancestor cast one last glance at the Master of Taixu before His figure disappeared.

...

Gazing at the palm-sized ax before him,

the Master of Taixu’s features fell into contemplation.

Evidently, ’Gray Ancestor’ was intensely eager for that Heart of Heavenly River.

The latter surely had something special about it, distinct from past condensed Hearts of Heavenly River.

But the Master of Taixu didn’t care about these details; he focused on the conditions ’Gray Ancestor’ set for him.

"Lord Mo Xu..."

The Master of Taixu sneered.

With this palm ax in hand, facing Lord Mo Xu, taken by surprise, he had a full chance of heavily injuring the opponent.

And once Lord Mo Xu was severely injured, the other time lifeforms were of little concern.

Then, by completing the transaction with ’Gray Ancestor,’ he could also secure the treasure he desired.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, dividing part of His mind to select suitable vessels for descent in the Third Source World.

The rest of His mind continued observing His own future timeline.

"Hmm?"

Simultaneously exploring hundreds of future timelines, Lin Yuan immediately spotted the images of the seven time lifeforms in the Chaos Void within the Milky Way dimension.

"Milky Way dimension? Heart of Heavenly River?"

Lin Yuan carefully observed; compared to what a First Realm time lifeform like Lord Mo Xu could see on the future timeline,

the timelines Lin Yuan was watching were much clearer. With the blessing of lord-level status, many concealed pieces of information couldn’t be hidden from him.

"This?"

Lin Yuan saw in a certain future timeline, the Master of Taixu fighting against Lord Mo Xu, finally raising His right hand, a palm-sized ax appearing, chopping toward Lord Mo Xu.

This strike gravely injured Lord Mo Xu, forcing the other time lifeforms into a retreat and escape.

The time lifeforms of the Chaos Void side suffered heavy losses, being besieged by Taixu dimension time lifeforms, ultimately resulting in even one time lifeform’s main battle body being entirely left behind.

"This ax?"

Lin Yuan watched as the Master of Taixu employed that palm-sized ax at the end.

The timeline expanded, and Lin Yuan quickly saw ’Gray Ancestor’s’ existence, His purpose for such actions, and the true value of the recently condensed Heart of Heavenly River.

"A Heart of Heavenly River with the potential to become lord-level material?"

Lin Yuan mused thoughtfully, then promptly summoned Lord Mo Xu and six other time lifeforms.

...

"Galaxy."

"Galaxy."

Moments later, the time lifeforms, including Lord Mo Xu, descended into incarnations, appearing before Lin Yuan.

"Over on the Milky Way dimension side..."

Lin Yuan looked at the time lifeforms without any pretense, "You cannot handle it."

With a Second Realm time lifeform like ’Gray Ancestor’ orchestrating, the time lifeforms on the Chaos Void side would face severe losses with the slightest negligence.

"Cannot handle it?"

Lord Mo Xu was shocked.

He too had been paying great attention to the Milky Way dimension, constantly watching the future timeline.

Yet he hadn’t discovered a scenario he couldn’t handle.

"Yes."

Lin Yuan nodded, "Having a Second Realm time lifeform secretly influencing behind the scenes, it’s normal for you not to notice."
